## Research question

How can we distinguish changes in vegetation from changes in hydroclimate in sedimentary plant-wax isotope records?

## About the project

My work on Lake Rotsee examines how vegetation changes affect the hydrogen-isotope composition of sedimentary plant waxes. Vegetation-corrected reconstructions help assess the hydroclimatic information preserved across the transition from the Younger Dryas into the Holocene and through later environmental change.

## Approach

Plant-wax δ²H and δ¹³C, lipid distributions, vegetation correction, and multi-proxy lake records.

- [Vegetation-corrected hydroclimate reconstruction · 2026 ↗](https://doi.org/10.1029/2025PA005401)
